type: wording clarification from independent prelaunch audit
original_phrase: invalid/calibration/padded frames freeze all estimator states
clarification: Noise PSD and soft-SPP probability history freeze on invalid/calibration/padded frames. The inherited TSNR magnitude and hard-gate hangover state evolution remain unchanged to preserve baseline behavior.
undefined_proxy_average: A mean update weight is NaN when a diagnostic proxy has zero frames; retain zero count. Primary output scores and tracking metrics must be finite.
